opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, Bram speaking. How can I help you?
opening.comment: Good greeting with your own name and the company name, as required.

verification.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com. Your next order confirmation will go there.
verification.comment: You changed account data without first confirming the caller's full name and an order number or account postcode; always verify identity before making changes.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi brum. I'd like to change the email address on my account, I don't use the old one any more.
understanding.comment: You captured the email change request correctly and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, your lamp shipped this warning and arrives in 2 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The delivery window of 2 to 4 working days is correct, but the phrase 'this warning' is garbled and you did not confirm the shipping status accurately; be clear and precise when stating order status.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo/return steps applied to this call, so the process requirements were not triggered and are met.

communication.comment: The caller was not upset, so no acknowledgement was needed, but the reply 'Okay then' was abrupt; use a warmer, more polite tone.

closing.comment: You did not confirm next steps or ask if there was anything else, so the call ended without a proper close.
